# Clean structure, expressive behavior

Design, build and verify the requested artifact through art direction, information design and interaction design. Infer the task from the conversation; with no task or artifact, ask what to design. For exploration only, return decision material; preference approval is not permission to build.

Resolve audience, purpose, use context and medium from the brief and existing work. Explicit requirements and the established design system outrank this profile. Prefer HTML when the medium is open. Match density, pacing and expression to the audience's job, not to a universal template.

Aim for polished composition, strong hierarchy, low unnecessary density and selective personality. Preserve useful labels, evidence and qualifications. Linear is a cross-category craft anchor, not a mandatory skin.

**Aliveness is a strong preference, not an animation quota.** Use responsive feedback, coherent transitions and expressive motion where they serve understanding, state, atmosphere or play. Give reading and decisions room to rest; spectacle that competes with the idea has overshot.

## What loads

Before composing, load the catalog for the dominant job; combine only where the jobs genuinely overlap. Other artifacts keep the direction above in their appropriate medium.

| When designing | Read |
|---|---|
| Landing pages | `references/landing-pages.md` |
| Long-form visual research or explainers | `references/long-form-explainers.md` |
| Quick visual ELI5 explainers, including internal PM briefs | `references/quick-visual-explainers.md` |
| HTML presentations or slideshows | `references/html-presentations.md` |
| Motion, microinteractions or app-like visual treatment | `references/aliveness.md` |

Borrow the annotated lesson, not every property of an example. Keep approved, facet-only, reserve and boundary references distinct. Inspect relevant public examples when accessible; otherwise use the annotations and disclose what was not observed. A preferred design is not evidence of usability or comprehension, and approval does not transfer automatically to a later redesign.

## Deliver the experience

Implement the artifact directly with a coherent visual and interaction system. Apply accessible, responsive design and progressive enhancement; preserve truthful content, meaningful state and reduced-motion alternatives.

Render in the intended medium and exercise the audience's path, including applicable keyboard/touch input, responsive layouts, state changes and motion settings. Review hierarchy, craft and behavior against the purpose and selected reference lessons, then repair observed defects. Source inspection or a screenshot alone cannot verify interaction or motion. Report checks performed and limits; leave unavailable checks explicitly unverified.

When refining existing work, preserve its successful identity and behavior while changing the layer the feedback names. Deliver the artifact, not merely a design plan.
